 // Folder 1

// This contains plots from the output file "sixth_test_run" generated by selecting the CCQE flag in the 'channel' branch in the 'h3' tree of the NUANCE output.

// This NUANCE output was generated with 317 files containing 1e10 -secs worth of events per file, as documented in the output folder of NUANCE.  

// The energy spectra is split into neutrino flavour as shown on the plots using the 'neutrino' brach of the 'h3' tree which corresponds to the PDG code of the neutrino flavour. 

// The CCQE Event Rate' plot in [nu/PoT/50 MeV] was generated to compare to Jen Raafs thesis Fig 6.5. 

//Thesis can be found at: https://www.osti.gov/biblio/15020150. 

// This folder also contains a preliminary cross section plot. The only useful channel is the NuMu at this stage due to low stats in the rest of them (Nue/Nuebar/Numubar). 

// These plots were made with the plotccqe.C macro and ...
